description: Hi! My name is Jeremy Boy. Data and AI leader with fifteen years of international experience, I have designed and implemented data strategies, governance frameworks, analytics platforms, and AI innovation programmes across the United Nations system. My background is interdisciplinary, and my experience combines strategic vision, technical expertise, operational leadership, academic recognition and policy engagement. I have a proven track record of transforming fragmented data assets into strategic capabilities that support decision-making and policy development, as well as of leading multidisciplinary teams and managing complex stakeholder ecosystems. I am now seeking to expand my experience at enterprise level by aligning data governance, responsible AI and organizational capability to create public value and accelerate the green transition.
